# Heavenly Treatments with Hayleybell

> A private cottage spa in Kelso, Scottish Borders, offering professional massage,
> facials, reflexology, body treatments, and seasonal treatments. Run by therapist
> Hayley in a calm, welcoming setting. Bookings are handled online via Fresha.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.heavenly-treatments.co.uk/): Overview of the spa, services, and how to book.
- [Treatments](https://www.heavenly-treatments.co.uk/treatments): Full treatment menu, grouped by category.
- [About](https://www.heavenly-treatments.co.uk/about): About Hayley and the cottage spa.
- [Contact](https://www.heavenly-treatments.co.uk/contact): Location, contact details, and enquiry form.
